title: Shard Dominion
description: Late-90s Westwood-style RTS: 13-mission two-act campaign with a real ending choice, 3 factions (Concord shields, Emberhand salvage+stealth; Shardborn roster in progress), tech tiers, real construction, air power, storms, a living planet that hunts the greedy, saves/replays, a mission kit, and experimental 1v1/2v2 lockstep.
